security.title: Security
security.subtitle: How you sign in and confirm sensitive actions.
security.biometricBody: Sign in and confirm payments, loans and data sharing with your phone's own fingerprint or face unlock.
security.privacyNote: Your fingerprint or face never leaves your phone. We only keep a public key from the device, and nothing biometric is ever written to the blockchain.
security.biometricOn: Fingerprint / face unlock is on for this device.
security.biometricCancelled: The fingerprint or face check didn't finish. Try again or use your PIN.
security.noPasskeyYet: Fingerprint sign-in isn't set up for this number yet. Sign in with your PIN, then turn it on in Profile & security.
security.pinBody: Works on every phone, including shared ones. Needed for sensitive actions if fingerprint isn't set up.
security.devicesSubtitle: Sign out anything you don't recognise.
security.newDeviceBody: This is the first sign-in from this device. We sent you an SMS about it.

pin.sharedPhoneHint: On a shared phone, only the account owner should enter the PIN.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Warnings about your farm, ghala, orders and account.
alerts.noneBody: We'll let you know here and by SMS when something changes.

irrigation.basedOn: Soil sensor + weather forecast + crop stage
irrigation.askWaited: Did you wait for the rain?
irrigation.thanks: Thanks. This is recorded in your farm history.

demo.humidDone: Simulated readings: humidity rising in the ghala.
demo.ventilatedDone: Simulated readings: conditions back to normal.

home.noFarmTitle: Add your farm to get started
home.noFarmBody: With your farm's location and soil we can give irrigation advice and track your season.

activity.verifiedNote: Each of these builds your verified record

farm.title: My farm
farm.subtitle: Soil, sensors, weather and crops for each of your fields.
farm.noFarmsBody: Add your first farm: name, location and soil type are enough to start.
farm.noSoilTestBody: A soil test (pH, N, P, K) from TARI or an extension officer makes advice more accurate.
farm.adviceSub: From your soil type and soil test
farm.noSensorBody: Advice uses the weather forecast only until a soil sensor is installed.
farm.stageHint: Keep the stage up to date: water needs change as the crop grows.
farm.name: Farm name
farm.gpsFailed: Couldn't get your location. Type it or try again outside.

ghala.farmerSubtitle: Your harvest batches, where they are stored and how they are keeping.
ghala.overviewSubtitle: Conditions inside the ghala and the stock you hold for farmers.
ghala.stockSubtitle: Every batch held here, with its storage condition.
ghala.intakeSubtitle: Weigh and grade produce, then issue a digital receipt.
ghala.quantityHint: Your own estimate; the ghala weighs it again.
ghala.batchHint: The batch gets a QR code, and a fingerprint of the record is stored on the blockchain so nobody can change it quietly later.
ghala.nextTakeToGhala: Next: take it to a verified ghala
ghala.nextTakeToGhalaBody: The operator weighs and grades it and issues a digital receipt. Then you can sell it in the marketplace.
ghala.noReadyCrop: No crop is ready to harvest
ghala.noReadyCropBody: Set a crop's stage to "Mature" in My farm when it's ready.
ghala.readyBody: Record the harvest to create a traceable batch with a QR code.
ghala.waitingSubtitle: Harvested but not yet weighed into storage.
ghala.nothingStoredBody: Batches appear here after a verified ghala weighs them in.
ghala.deliverHint: Take this batch to a verified ghala. After it is weighed and graded you can sell it.
ghala.deliverOperatorHint: Use Intake to weigh and grade this batch.
ghala.riskMeta: Safe storage ranges for dry grain, last 24 hours
ghala.anchoredSummariesSub: Summaries of the sensor readings, secured on the blockchain.
ghala.receiptLegal: A platform record, not a legal warehouse receipt under the regulated system.
ghala.noReceiptBody: The ghala issues one at intake.
ghala.sellSubtitle: Set a price; buyers see verified stock and storage history.
ghala.priceHint: Check local market prices before you set it.
ghala.listedToast: Your batch is now in the marketplace.
ghala.anchorSubtitle: Summarise the readings since the last record and store its fingerprint on the blockchain.
ghala.noWarehouse: No ghala is linked to this account.
ghala.selectBatch: Choose a batch on the left
ghala.noPendingBody: Harvests farmers record appear here until you weigh them in.

market.title: Marketplace

market.rankingHint: verified and low storage risk first, then price

market.noListingsBody: Try another crop or region, or clear the filters.

market.requestSent: Request sent. You'll be notified when the farmer replies.
market.largeOrderNote: Requests above TZS 500,000 need your confirmation.
market.trustBody_one: {{count}} record checked against its blockchain proof.
market.trustBody_other: {{count}} records checked against their blockchain proofs.
market.contactAfterAccept: Contact details are shared once the order is accepted.
market.priceSetBy: Price set by the farmer or co-op.
market.farmerSubtitle: Purchase requests from buyers and the stock you are selling.
market.noRequestsBody: Buyers' requests appear here, and by SMS.
market.nothingListedBody: Set a price on a stored batch to put it in the marketplace.

waitingOn.warehouse: Waiting for the ghala to release

done.accept: Order accepted. The buyer can now pay.
done.deliver: Delivery confirmed. Both sides now confirm the sale.

orders.paymentSimulated: Mobile-money payment is simulated in this demo; no money moves.
orders.buyerSubtitle: Track each request from acceptance to a verified sale.
orders.warehouseSubtitle: Paid orders waiting for you to release stock.
orders.noneOpenBody: Find verified stock in the marketplace.

finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Your verified farming record, and the loans, insurance and savings it can support.

profile.title: Profile & security
profile.subtitle: Your account, language and sign-in security.
profile.languageHint: Used in the app and for SMS alerts.
profile.youControl: You choose who sees this, in Data sharing.
profile.safeWindows: Storage records in the safe range
profile.cashFlowSub: When money is expected to come in, so repayments can match your harvest.
profile.priceBasis: Based on {{price}}/kg {{source}} and typical yields; a range, not a promise.
profile.noCashFlow: Add a growing crop with a harvest date to see an estimate.
profile.contestSub: If a sale, harvest or storage record is missing or wrong, tell us.
profile.contestBody: A person reviews every request and corrects the record if needed.
profile.contestPlaceholder: Example: my sale to Tanzanite Foods in June is missing
profile.contestSent: Sent. A person will review it.

loans.productSub: Sized to your seasonal cash flow
loans.noProduct: Add a growing crop with a harvest date to get a suggestion.

elig.receipts: Produce stored with a ghala receipt

loans.eligibilityNote: These are indicators only. The lender decides.
loans.overSuggested: Above the suggested amount; the lender may offer less.
loans.consentNote: Applying shares your profile, production, storage, sales and receipts with this lender for 90 days. You can stop it any time in Data sharing.
loans.decisionNote: A loan officer reviews your application and decides. The platform doesn't approve or decline loans.
loans.submitted: Application sent. You'll get an SMS when the lender decides.
loans.noneBody: When you apply, you can follow every step here.

insurance.riskSub: From your farm location and ghala records
insurance.droughtProne: {{region}} is drought-prone: low rain is the main risk to your crop.
insurance.noDrought: No major climate risk recorded for your area.
insurance.consentNote: Your profile, production and storage records are shared with the insurer for 180 days. The insurer decides.
insurance.noPoliciesBody: Request cover above; the insurer confirms it.
insurance.threshold: Pays if season rain is below {{mm}} mm
insurance.rainfall: {{mm}} mm of rain so far (trigger: below {{threshold}} mm)
insurance.humanNote: A rainfall trigger only proposes a claim. The insurer reviews and decides.

savings.planNote: A starting point. Change it to fit your family.
savings.noIncome: No verified income yet to plan with.
savings.noGoalsBody: Start with next season's seed and fertiliser.
savings.recordHint: Record money you've put aside in mobile money, VICOBA or a SACCO.
savings.futureLink: Linking a mobile-money wallet, SACCO or VICOBA account is planned.

consent.youDecide: You decide who sees your record
consent.explainer: Choose who, what, why and for how long. You can stop sharing at any time, and you can see every time someone looked.
consent.confirmNote: They will only see what you choose, for this purpose, until it expires or you stop it.
consent.noAccess: Nobody has looked at your record yet.

lender.overviewSubtitle: Applications backed by verified farm, storage and sales records.
lender.humanOnly: Profiles are decision support. Your credit officers decide, and every decision is recorded with a reason.
lender.applicationsSubtitle: Each application comes with the farmer's consent and verified record.
lender.noConsent: The farmer's consent has ended, so their record is hidden.
lender.accessLogged: Your access is logged and visible to the farmer.
lender.reasonHint: Required to approve or decline. The farmer sees it.
lender.recorded: Decision recorded. The farmer was notified by SMS.
lender.bookSubtitle: Approved loans and when repayment is due.
lender.bookNote: Due amounts are simple estimates; your core banking system is the record.

partners.farmersSubtitle: Farmers who have shared their record with you.
partners.noFarmers: No farmers are sharing with you
partners.noFarmersBody: Farmers choose to share when they apply or request cover.

insurer.overviewSubtitle: Policies, farm risk and claims backed by weather and ghala records.
insurer.humanOnly: Triggers and profiles inform you; your underwriters and claims staff decide.
insurer.policiesSubtitle: Activate or decline requested cover and check rainfall triggers.
insurer.claimsSubtitle: Review the evidence and record a decision.
insurer.claimRecorded: Decision recorded. The farmer was notified.

meaning.VERIFIED: Every record matches the fingerprint stored on the blockchain when it was made. Nothing has been changed since.
meaning.MISMATCH: At least one record no longer matches its fingerprint. Treat this batch with caution and contact the platform.
meaning.NOT_ANCHORED: The record exists, but its fingerprint hasn't been stored yet.
meaning.PARTIAL: Some records are verified; the rest haven't been secured yet.

verify.eventsSub: Each step was recorded when it happened.
verify.ownershipNote: Buyer names are not shown publicly.
verify.trustBody: Anyone can scan this QR to check the batch's journey.
verify.simulatedHint: In this demo, proofs go to a local tamper-evident ledger instead of a public chain.
verify.scanSubtitle: Scan the QR on a bag or receipt, or type the code.
verify.scanUnsupported: This browser can't scan. Type the code printed under the QR instead.
verify.cameraDenied: Camera permission was refused. Type the code instead.
verify.badCode: That doesn't look like a batch, receipt or sale code.
verify.buyerSubtitle: Check any batch's journey before and after you buy.
verify.noBatchesYet: You haven't ordered any batches yet.

suppliers.subtitle: Farmers and co-ops with stock in verified ghalas.

admin.title: Platform overview
admin.subtitle: Operations, fraud signals and the audit trail.
admin.fraudSubtitle: Rule-based signals: impossible sensor values, duplicate batches, quantity mismatches, contested records.
admin.auditSubtitle: Who did what, when and why, including every read of a farmer's record.
admin.smsHint: Each SMS goes out in the recipient's language. Without a gateway key they are logged, not sent.
admin.demoSubtitle: Tools for showing the trust layer live.
admin.demoWarning: Demo only: these edit the database directly. Disabled when DEV_MODE is off.
admin.tamperExplainer: Quietly change a batch's quantity in the database, then open its verified record: it shows "Changed". Restore to put it back.
admin.tamperDone: {{id}} now says {{qty}} kg in the database. Open its verified record.
